cases.instruction: Repair _bounded in src/vare/source_navigation_v1.py. Apply a minimal source edit and then call finish.
cases.prompt: Repair SourceNavigatorV1._bounded in src/vare/source_navigation_v1.py. Search indexes up to 128 valid source paths. With many long paths, the indexed_paths metadata can exhaust the serialized JSON response budget, removing every useful match and yielding output_limit_too_small. Preserve useful ranked matches when the auxiliary inventory is too large. Every response must still fit max_output_bytes and report an accurate output_bytes when present. Keep existing invalid-query and no-match behavior. Change only the body of _bounded, preserving its signature and every other definition. Do not add imports, IO, reflection, nested definitions, or changes to module state. Hidden behavioral checks run only after the attempt. This is Development feasibility, not held-out evaluation.

Change only the body of search, preserving its signature and every other definition. Do not add imports, IO, reflection, nested definitions, or changes to module state. Hidden behavioral checks run only after the attempt. This is Development feasibility, not held-out evaluation.

cases.prompt: Repair manifest_entries in scripts/verify_coding_agent_evidence_manifest_v1.py. A manifest that omits files, or supplies an empty object or empty array, currently verifies zero files and can be reported as completed. Require a nonempty files inventory. Invalid inventory must return a nonempty errors list with no entries. Continue to support nonempty path-map and array formats, retaining duplicate-path and malformed-array checks. Change only the body of manifest_entries, preserving its signature and every other definition. Do not add imports, IO, reflection, nested definitions, or changes to module state. Hidden behavioral checks run only after the attempt. This is Development feasibility, not held-out evaluation.

cheaper_alternative: Unit regressions and baseline/fix/mutant qualification first; they can establish the defect and oracle but cannot establish model tool use or model-generated repair.
claim_boundary: Development on three narrow VARE module contracts, two related task families, public future-code exposure unknown. No independent external review, held-out gain, trained-policy gain, or general repository-agent success claim.
decision: Even a positive result only permits considering a separate update-cost smoke. No training admitted while eligible independent held-out data is insufficient.
fault_experiment: One actual SIGKILL after durable model rollout before grading; recovery must bind every pending artifact, grade the retained candidate once, and retain exactly one model invocation. No within-generation recovery or speedup claim.
hypothesis: The cached Qwen3-4B checkpoint, whose tool-call template does not contain the invalid doubled JSON braces observed in the 3B template, may complete valid source inspection and repair under the CPU resource caps. Its three task/model cells have never run in this sprint.

predecessor.cpu_outcome: Qwen2.5-3B CPU: both attempts completed and graded false, no edits, invalid doubled-brace JSON at turn one. Full outcomes retained. No consumed 3B task/model cell is rerun.
predecessor.result: First Metal attempt aborted on host swap growth before any completed generation; five cells not admitted. Original interrupted task/model cell retired.

primary_metric: Verified task success, valid tool calls and source edits on three Development contracts, one greedy attempt per task. This is a distinct checkpoint/interface resource screen, not a matched causal comparison with Qwen2.5.
stopping: Shared resource/inference failure stops remaining cells. No outcome-driven retries, prompt edits, or grader changes. Always grade completed unchanged candidates as failures.
